title: Medical Assistance Verification Documents and Clinical Eligibility on File
content:
**Standard.** The business office gathers the verification documents the County Assistance Office lists and forwards each one within the verification forward days of receiving it, counting business days Monday through Friday excluding center holidays; bank statements cover the whole look-back period. A clinical eligibility determination for nursing facility care must be on file before the case can be approved. A document type is forwarded once per forwarding date.

For Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage the forwarding window is 2 business days, the look-back period is 60 months, and the County Assistance Office's decision standards are 45 days (90 days where a disability determination is required).

**Expressed as conditions and results.**

| Condition | Result |
|---|---|
| A listed verification document is received | it is forwarded within 2 business days, Monday through Friday excluding center holidays |
| Bank statements are gathered | they cover the whole 60-month look-back period |
| No clinical eligibility determination for nursing facility care is on file | the case cannot yet be approved |
| A document type has already been forwarded on a given date | it is not forwarded again on that same date |

**Hypothetical counting example.** A life insurance statement is received on a Friday; the following Monday is a center holiday. Business day 1 is Tuesday and business day 2 is Wednesday, so Wednesday is the last day within the window.
